_comment: Psychiatric-pipeline endpoint. Follows the exact registry shape established for herg_inhibition_v1.json / cyp3a4_inhibition_v1.json -- registering this makes BBB loadable through the SAME generic drugsim_predict.model_registry/pipeline.run_inference machinery those two already use, no new serving-path code required. NOT YET wired into the live deployment (deployment/docker/Dockerfile.predict-api and render.yaml still list only hERG/CYP3A4's GitHub Release assets) -- that is a separate, deliberate deploy step, not done in this pass.

final_report_status_history.note: Registered offline for local/offline multi-objective screening use. Not promoted to VALIDATED FOR INTERNAL RESEARCH -- no external validation performed yet.

endpoint.name: Blood-brain-barrier permeability
endpoint.definition: label=1 (BBB-permeant) / label=0 (BBB-non-permeant), as published by Martins et al. 2012 (already binary at the source)
endpoint.target: N/A -- whole-organism passive/measured brain-plasma partitioning, not a single-protein target
endpoint.scientific_caveat: A binary passive/measured brain-plasma partitioning call, not CNS efficacy or exposure at a therapeutic dose. 'BBB-permeant' does not mean 'clinically active in the CNS.' See docs/psychiatric-pipeline/scientific-foundation.md's BBB-lipophilicity section.

dataset.source: TDC (Therapeutics Data Commons), Martins et al. 2012 BBB dataset, complete population as published (2,039 raw compounds)
dataset.note: PyTDC's own downloader returned HTTP 403 in this environment (no User-Agent set); fetched directly via httpx against the same public Dataverse file ID with an explicit User-Agent instead -- see fetch_tdc_data.py's docstring. Not B3DB -- see docs/psychiatric-pipeline/data-sources.md's substitution reasoning.

features.note: feature_set_id is IDENTICAL to hERG/CYP3A4/DRD2/HRH1/CYP2D6's -- a content address over the shared descriptor/fingerprint/standardisation/RDKit-version toolchain (ADR-005), not a per-dataset identifier.

external_validation.reason: No independent second-source BBB dataset identified in this pass.

artifact.note: gitignored binary, not committed, same convention as hERG/CYP3A4's artifacts.
artifact.reproducibility: regenerate via: fetch_tdc_data.py -> build_dataset.py -> prepare_features.py -> train.py, in order, RANDOM_SEED=42 fixed throughout.

inference_support._comment: Frozen conformal calibration + AD reference data exported by models/psychiatric/bbb_permeability/10_export_inference_support.py -- never recomputed at inference time.

deployment_status.note: Not referenced by deployment/docker/Dockerfile.predict-api or render.yaml's MODEL_RELEASE_URL_BASE assets -- the live drugsim-predict-api service does not serve this model_id yet. Loadable today only from a local checkout with the local artifact files present (e.g. for the psychiatric-pipeline's offline multi-objective screening script).
